en: Architectural cross‑section drawing of a multi‑storey residential building labeled with numbered rooms and spaces, accompanied by Finnish text explaining the layout. The title at the top reads "Karjalaisten koti." and below the drawing is the address "Helsinki, Liisank. 17, Oikok. 5" followed by a numbered legend describing various facilities such as dining hall, cellar, sauna, laundry and others. The style resembles an early 20th‑century informative or promotional postcard showing the design of a communal house.
